title: Whiskey Cocktails
subtitle: The Old Fashioned, the Manhattan and the Sazerac
description: How the 1806 cocktail of spirit, sugar, water and bitters became the Old Fashioned, the Manhattan and the Sazerac. Four drinks to make and taste.

pours.name: Plain whiskey cocktail
pours.style: Built in the glass, Small tumbler
pours.notes: Make it as the 1806 definition reads. Taste it with no ice, then add one cube.

pours.name: Old Fashioned
pours.notes: Sugar, bitters, bourbon and a twist of orange peel, stirred over ice. No muddled fruit.

pours.name: Manhattan
pours.notes: Two parts rye to one of sweet vermouth, with bitters, stirred until very cold.

pours.name: Sazerac
pours.notes: Rinse the glass with absinthe, strain in the drink with no ice, and throw away the lemon peel.
